note.en: The current fork requires a non-word character after the closing `$`, so `$a$b` stays literal text; the reference closes the formula before `b`.
note.zh: 当前分支要求闭 `$` 后为非单词字符，因此 `$a$b` 保持为字面文本；参考包会在 `b` 之前闭合公式。

note.en: The current fork requires a non-word character before the opening `$`, so `a$x$` stays literal text; the reference parses the formula.
note.zh: 当前分支要求开 `$` 前为非单词字符，因此 `a$x$` 保持为字面文本；参考包会将其解析为公式。

note.en: The current fork never closes a formula when the closing `$` is immediately followed by another `$`, so the whole line stays literal; the reference parses `$a$` and `$b$` as two formulas.
note.zh: 当闭 `$` 后紧跟另一个 `$` 时，当前分支不会闭合公式，因此整行保持为字面文本；参考包会把 `$a$` 和 `$b$` 解析为两个公式。

cases.name: literal-gap-inline

note.en: The current fork treats a space-surrounded `$` inside a formula as literal content and keeps scanning for the closing delimiter; the reference gives up at the first `$` that cannot close and emits literal text.
note.zh: 当前分支将公式内被空格包围的 `$` 视为字面内容并继续扫描闭合分隔符；参考包在第一个无法闭合的 `$` 处放弃，并输出字面文本。

cases.ourHtml:
paragraph_open:""
inline:"$\\text{a $ b}$"
  math_inline{$}:"\\text{a $ b}"
paragraph_close:""
cases.referenceHtml:
paragraph_open:""
inline:"$\\text{a $ b}$"
  text:"$\\text{a $ b}$"
paragraph_close:""

cases.name: block-trailing-content

note.en: A single-line `$$...$$` followed by non-whitespace content is deliberately not treated as a block by the current fork (the trailing content stays a paragraph); the reference swallows the entire line into one display formula.
note.zh: 单行 `$$...$$` 后接非空白内容时，当前分支有意不将其视为块（后续内容仍为段落）；参考包会把整行吞入一个块级公式。

cases.ourHtml:
paragraph_open:""
inline:"$$a$$ tail"
  text:"$$a$$ tail"
paragraph_close:""

note.en: Same as `block-trailing-content`: the current fork falls back to a paragraph and parses `$b$` as inline math, while the reference emits one display formula containing the whole line.
note.zh: 与 `block-trailing-content` 相同：当前分支回退为段落并将 `$b$` 解析为行内公式，而参考包输出一个包含整行的块级公式。

note.en: The current fork only emits a math block when a closing `$$` exists; the reference emits an empty `math_block` token for a lone `$$`.
note.zh: 当前分支仅在存在闭合 `$$` 时输出数学块；参考包会为单独的 `$$` 输出一个空的 `math_block` token。

notes.en: `@mdit/plugin-tex` is a fork of `markdown-it-katex` with a pluggable renderer and a required `render` option, so rendered output is not comparable: the reference always renders KaTeX HTML while this package delegates rendering. Both sides are compared on the parsed token stream instead (token type, markup, content, and text tokens, so differences in literal `$` handling are visible).
notes.zh: `@mdit/plugin-tex` 是 `markdown-it-katex` 的分支，渲染器可插拔且必须提供 `render` 选项，因此无法比较渲染输出：参考包始终渲染 KaTeX HTML，而当前包把渲染委托出去。两侧改为比较解析后的 token 流（token 类型、markup、content 以及文本 token，因此字面量 `$` 处理上的差异可见）。

notes.en: The required `render` option of the current package is set to a deterministic stub (`\(...\)` / `\[...\]`). It is never invoked because the comparison reads the parsed tokens instead of rendering them, so no real KaTeX work happens on either side.
notes.zh: 当前包必需的 `render` 选项被设为一个确定性的桩函数（`\(...\)` / `\[...\]`）。由于比较读取的是解析后的 token 而非渲染结果，该函数从未被调用，两侧都不会执行真正的 KaTeX 计算。

notes.en: Math token content is compared after trimming edge whitespace. The reference trims the first line of a block formula and drops the trailing newline, while the current package preserves both; both implementations pass the same formula payload to their renderer, so the edge formatting is not a behavioral difference and the case `block-edge-space` is reported as an exact match.
notes.zh: 数学 token 的内容在去掉首尾空白后比较。参考包会裁掉块级公式首行的空白并丢弃末尾换行，当前包则两者都保留；两种实现传给渲染器的公式载荷相同，因此边缘格式不属于行为差异，`block-edge-space` 用例被报告为完全一致。

notes.en: Edge formatting aside, the token streams match on inline math, `$$` fences, escaping, unmatched delimiters, an effectively empty document, and markdown constructs that must not be parsed as math (code spans, fences). Labels are not implemented by either plugin, so no `math_block_label` tokens are compared.
notes.zh: 除边缘格式外，两侧 token 流在行内公式、`$$` 围栏、转义、未匹配分隔符、实际为空的文档以及不应被解析为数学的 Markdown 结构（行内代码、围栏代码块）上完全一致。两个插件都未实现标签，因此没有比较 `math_block_label` token。

notes.en: Documented differences, inherited from the current fork's stricter delimiter rules: opening `$` needs a non-word character before it and closing `$` needs a non-word character after it (`$a$b`, `a$x$`), an inline `$` surrounded by whitespace inside a formula is treated as literal and scanning continues (`$\text{a $ b}$`), a closing `$` may not be immediately followed by another `$` (`$a$$b$`), a single-line `$$...$$` followed by inline content is not a block (`$$a$$ tail`), and `$$` alone is not a math block.
notes.zh: 已记录差异源自当前分支更严格的分隔符规则：开 `$` 前必须是单词字符以外的字符，闭 `$` 后必须是单词字符以外的字符（`$a$b`、`a$x$`）；公式内被空白包围的行内 `$` 视为字面量并继续扫描（`$\text{a $ b}$`）；闭 `$` 后不能紧跟另一个 `$`（`$a$$b$`）；单行 `$$...$$` 后接行内内容时不构成块（`$$a$$ tail`）；单独的 `$$` 不是数学块。

notes.en: Fork-only behavior is not compared because the reference has no equivalent option: bracket delimiters (`\(...\)` / `\[...\]`), `mathFence` (```` ```math ````), `allowInlineWithSpace`, and the `render` callback itself.
notes.zh: 以下仅当前分支具备的行为因参考包没有对应选项而不参与比较：方括号分隔符（`\(...\)` / `\[...\]`）、`mathFence`（```` ```math ````）、`allowInlineWithSpace` 以及 `render` 回调本身。

notes.en: Benchmarks measure parsing only on both sides (the stub renderer is never called and the reference renderer is not invoked), so the two sides do the same work. The corpora stay small on purpose: 24 inline formulas for `normal/large` and 24 inline plus 8 display formulas for `heavy/large`.
notes.zh: 基准测试在两侧都只测量解析（桩渲染器从不被调用，参考包的渲染器也不会被调用），因此两侧做的工作相同。语料刻意保持较小：`normal/large` 含 24 个行内公式，`heavy/large` 含 24 个行内公式和 8 个块级公式。

notes.en: Scaling series probe the delimiter scanners: many unmatched `$$` fence lines (the paragraph terminator probes the block rule once per line; the current package memoizes unsuccessful closing-marker look-aheads and stays linear, while the reference short-circuits in silent mode and then consumes the rest of the document as a single block), many inline formulas, and many closed multi-line `$$` fences (the reference re-scans the document prefix to find the closing line).
notes.zh: 扩展性系列针对分隔符扫描器：大量未匹配的 `$$` 围栏行（段落终止判断每行都会探测一次块级规则；当前包会缓存失败的闭合标记前瞻并保持线性，而参考包在 silent 模式下提前返回，随后把文档剩余部分当作单个块消费）、大量行内公式，以及大量成对的跨行 `$$` 围栏（参考包会重新扫描文档前缀以寻找闭合行）。
